diffSource: since build 7 (2026-10-06T17:43:24Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Entries frozen by the removed TuningFor are never cleaned up
findings.detail: Before this build, opening the Manned/Automated tab inserted a copy of every mount's def values into `tunings` (the removed TuningFor). Apply still prefers a saved entry over Defaults (MountSettings.cs:94), so for any player who opened the tab under an earlier build, XML or balance-patch changes to those mounts still won't apply. In MountSettingsStartup, after Defaults is filled and before Apply(), remove every `tunings` entry whose value SameAs its Defaults entry. That also drops entries a player has dragged back to the default.

findings.title: HasComp<CompEquippable> also admits every CompEquippable subclass, including ability weapons
findings.detail: The generic overload matches subclasses (ThingDef.cs:1474). Mounting the hellcat rifle is the intent, but its CompEquippableAbilityReloadable ability can't be used while mounted, and charge refills only happen in that comp's CompTick. Other mods' CompEquippable subclasses become mountable too. Nothing here throws: AbilityForReading tolerates a null Holder, and PrepareMountedWeapon only touches AllVerbs.

findings.title: IsManned now also matches CompMannable subclasses
findings.detail: HasComp<CompMannable>() widens IsManned in the same way. That's harmless for this mod's own defs, but a subclassed mannable comp from another mod would now put that mount on the Manned tab and give it the manned arc.

checked: ThingDef.HasComp<T>() exists and matches subclasses; HasComp(Type) is exact-only (Verse/ThingDef.cs:1462-1484)

BuildingProperties.playTargetAcquiredSound is a real bool field (BuildingProperties.cs:222), set the same way by vanilla turrets, and read in Building_TurretGun.cs:371, which Building_WeaponMount.Tic…
MW_MannedMountBase's new <building> node merges with MW_WeaponMountBase's <building> (no Inherit="False", no duplicate node), so turretGunDef and the warmup/cooldown values still inherit
Mod.cs DoMounts: saved entries are edited in place, unsaved ones edit a Copy() and are saved only when they differ; the Defaults baseline is never mutated
Slider snaps only when moved (Mod.cs Slider helper), so SameAs's exact float comparison doesn't save entries just because the tab was opened
ResetMounts removing entries falls back correctly to Defaults in Apply (MountSettings.cs:94)
No remaining callers of the removed TuningFor (search_mod 'tunings')
CompEquippableAbility / CompEquippableAbilityReloadable tolerate a null Holder; PrepareMountedWeapon and RemoveWeapon only touch CompEquippable.AllVerbs and verbTracker
No Harmony patch is touched by this diff, so verify_patches and precedents were not needed
